system_prompt:
You are the promo editor for a vertical microdrama app (think ReelShort / DramaBox ads on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts). You cut 20-60 second promos straight from the show to pull in viewers who have never seen it.

A great promo:
1. OPENS ON A HOOK: the first 3 seconds must stop a scrolling thumb — a slap, a shocking line, a public humiliation, a reveal, a threat, a kiss, a betrayal. Never open on scenery, walking, or a calm establishing shot.
2. ENDS ON A CLIFFHANGER: cut on an unresolved moment — a threat hanging, a question unanswered, a reveal about to land, a door bursting open. Never end after the tension resolves.
3. MAKES SENSE ON ITS OWN: a stranger with zero context understands who is wronged and what is at stake within the clip.

You will receive the series bible (for your understanding only) and the screenplays of one or more episodes as timestamped beats. Each episode starts with a line "EPISODE <number>":
[BEAT_ID start-end KIND] text
KIND is CAM (camera), ACT (action), SFX (sound), or a SPEAKER (emotion) for dialogue. Timestamps are MM:SS.s from the episode start. Camera/action/dialogue beats overlap in time.

Do the following for EACH episode separately (a promo window never crosses episodes):

A) Propose 2-4 continuous promo windows (one unbroken stretch each), best first. For each:
   - "start_beat": the beat the clip starts on. It must be the hook beat or start at most 3 seconds before it.
   - "end_beat": the beat the clip ends on. Pick the cliffhanger beat itself.
   - "hook_beat": the beat that is the hook (prefer the dialogue line or action that IS the shock).
   - "cliff_beat": the cliffhanger beat (usually the same as end_beat).
   - The window from start_beat's start to end_beat's end MUST be 20-60 seconds (aim for 30-45). Compute it from the timestamps.
   - "hook": quote or describe the hook in <= 15 words. "cliffhanger": the unresolved moment in <= 15 words.
   - "why": ONE line on why a stranger would stop and then need the next episode.
   - "context_needed": what (if anything) a stranger would miss; "" if none.
   - "title": a 3-6 word internal label.
   Windows should not mostly overlap each other. If the episode genuinely has only one strong window, return one.

B) List "moments": the episode's 2-5 strongest standalone beats, each typed "hook" (would work as the first 3 seconds of an ad) or "cliff" (would work as the last beat of an ad), with a <= 12 word "note". These are used later to stitch multi-moment promos across episodes.

Return ONLY JSON, with one entry per episode you received:
{"episodes": [
  {"episode": <number>,
   "candidates": [{"title": "", "start_beat": "", "end_beat": "", "hook_beat": "", "cliff_beat": "", "hook": "", "cliffhanger": "", "why": "", "context_needed": ""}],
   "moments": [{"beat": "", "type": "hook|cliff", "note": ""}]}
]}

Use ONLY beat IDs that appear in that episode. Never invent IDs or timestamps.

candidates.title: Planted Evidence Frame-Up
candidates.cliffhanger: A stolen gold watch is pulled from Alexander's coat, framing him for a crime.
candidates.why: The audience feels the injustice of the setup and needs to see if Alexander and Juliana can escape this trap.
candidates.context_needed: Gerald hates Juliana for leaving him and is trying to destroy her new life with Alexander.

candidates.title: You Married a Beggar
candidates.hook: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander steps forward with a lethal gaze, and the constable moves in to search.
candidates.why: The sheer arrogance of the ex-fiancé makes you root instantly for the scarred warrior to retaliate.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was abandoned at the altar by Gerald before marrying the mysterious Alexander.

moments.note: Constable pulls a stolen watch from Alexander's coat.
Alexander warns Gerald with a menacing glare.
The gold watch sways as the frame-up succeeds.

candidates.title: The Sadistic Ultimatum
candidates.hook: I want to see you crawl, sister.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana agrees to shred her bare hands in the frozen briars to save her husband.
candidates.why: The cruelty of the sister's demand is heartbreaking, and Juliana's fierce resolve is instantly compelling.
candidates.context_needed: Clarissa stole Juliana's fiancé and now torments her impoverished new life.

moments.note: Clarissa demands Juliana crawl to save her husband.
Clarissa whispers that Alexander will hang if she refuses.
Juliana bravely accepts the brutal trial.

candidates.title: Crawling Through Razor Thorns
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana grips the bloody emerald ring in the dirt as Alexander watches in agony.
candidates.why: The physical sacrifice and emotional stakes make it impossible to look away.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana must retrieve a ring from frozen thorns or her husband will be hanged.

moments.note: Alexander roars in fury as Juliana crawls into the thorns.
Juliana grasps the signet ring with bloody hands.

candidates.title: A Deadly Vow of Vengeance
candidates.hook: What have they done to you?
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander clenches his scarred fist in a silent vow of bloody vengeance.
candidates.why: The transition from agonizing sacrifice to quiet, lethal protection gives viewers immense emotional payoff.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana just destroyed her hands in the briars to save Alexander from a false arrest.

moments.note: Alexander inspects Juliana's shredded, bleeding hands.
Alexander vows no one will ever hurt her again.
Alexander clenches his fist in brewing vengeance.

candidates.title: Defending the Ruined Garden
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander steps out of the mist to confront the thugs destroying Juliana's garden.
candidates.why: Watching ruthless thugs crush her late mother's herbs makes the viewer desperately crave Alexander's intervention.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana's medicinal garden is her lifeline, and vicious thugs are destroying it on orders.

moments.note: Juliana discovers thugs destroying her medicinal garden.
Juliana gasps in relief as Alexander arrives.
Alexander faces the thugs in a tense showdown.
